fee_notes: Affiliation fee is $500 per room for new franchises with a $75,000 minimum (conversion or new construction), and $750 per room with a $75,000 minimum for transfers and renewals. The fee is non-refundable after franchisor signs the Franchise Agreement. During the 12 months ending December 31, 2025, affiliation fees ranged from $50,000 to $60,000 for executed agreements. Reductions have been granted in certain circumstances (multiple-unit franchisees, larger properties, prior relationships, etc.) but are not guaranteed. No upper bound is disclosed as a fixed cap — fee scales per room count, so high end is indeterminate from the text.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us, for the rights granted to you in the RADISSON INDIVIDUALS Franchise Agreement, an affiliation fee of $500 per room for new franchises, with a $75,000 minimum for new franchises (through conversion of an existing hotel or newly constructing a hotel), and $750 per room with a $75,000 minimum for transfers and renewals. ... During the 12 months ending December 31, 2025, the affiliation fees ranged in the amount of $50,000 - $60,000 for our RADISSON INDIVIDUALS franchise agreements.
